intents_zh: 容器 cpu mem 即時
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

while true; do
  clear
  printf "%-20s %-15s %-10s %-12s %-20s\n" NAME STATE CPU% MEM IMAGE
  echo "----------------------------------------------------------------------"
  docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Image}}' | while IFS=$'\t' read -r name status image; do
    stats=$(docker stats "$name" --no-stream --format '{{.CPUPerc}}\t{{.MemUsage}}' 2>/dev/null || echo "-\t-")
    cpu=$(echo "$stats" | cut -f1)
    mem=$(echo "$stats" | cut -f2 | awk '{print $1}')
    printf "%-20s %-15s %-10s %-12s %-20s\n" "$name" "${status:0:14}" "$cpu" "$mem" "$image"
  done
  sleep 2
done
